R1_MINIMAL_SPACE_DELTA_ACROSS_REENTRY_SU.acceptance: Surface is mind-sized but includes a delta line and deeper evidence handle.
R1_MINIMAL_SPACE_DELTA_ACROSS_REENTRY_SU.rule: Merge outputs, role reviews, and operator surfaces must include one compact minimal_space_delta line plus evidence handles when reentry could lose packet-level context.

R2_CONTINUATION_INTAKE_NEXT_LANE_LOOKUP.acceptance: Short continuation must cite latest next-lane evidence in space_reference_delta.
R2_CONTINUATION_INTAKE_NEXT_LANE_LOOKUP.rule: For continuation-only user inputs, preserve raw original, read latest next-lane card, then classify intent/budget. Do not infer next lane from model memory alone.

R3_SOURCE_SELECTION_REJECTED_REF_LOG.acceptance: Selected refs have changed_judgment; rejected refs have reason; rejected refs are not silently reintroduced.
R3_SOURCE_SELECTION_REJECTED_REF_LOG.rule: Source-selection surfaces must record rejected refs with reasons when rejection prevents archaeology, overload, or decorative citation.

R4_ROLE_HANDOFF_UNIQUE_DELTA_METRIC.acceptance: Comparison explains why both agents were useful or why one should be skipped/reviewed.
R4_ROLE_HANDOFF_UNIQUE_DELTA_METRIC.rule: When Codex/Gemini heavy mode is used, record each agent unique_delta and classify overlap as productive, duplicative, or conflicting.

R5_VALIDATOR_WORDING_SCOPE_GUARD.acceptance: Watch future validators; do not harden now without recurrence.
R5_VALIDATOR_WORDING_SCOPE_GUARD.rule: If wording false positives recur, distinguish exclusion wording from target classification.

agent_role_contract: unique_delta + overlap classification in heavy mode
budget_contract: default FAST for known safe lanes
HEAVY only for explicit agent role test, architecture ambiguity, drift/risk, or cross-agent comparison
merge_contract: original + selected refs + model reasoning merge

not_authority: This contract is an applied evidence/spec artifact, not authority, registry, current-position, or promotion.

phase_model.Phase1: whole-flow rehearsal: actual processing loop, not internal validator/card substrate only
phase_model.Phase2: function placement/testing against Phase1 whole-flow stages with observed gaps and Phase3 backlog deltas
phase_model.Phase3: batched revision based on accumulated Phase2 observations, not one-by-one convergence patches

space_reference_delta.changed_judgment: Execution target is new applied operating-structure contract artifact, not mutating authority/source.
R1-R4 move from plan to bounded contract rules; R5 remains watch-only.
Applied rules remain grouped by repeated patterns and whole-flow stages.
Approval is interpreted as bounded apply lane only because exact authority mutation was not named.
